scope: Separate unwired B4/T4/T32 reference. Offline sm120 CUDA13.2/VS2022 compile only; no local GPU or program execution. Rounds current K/V to BF16 then FP32 and invokes unchanged legacy full-cache FP32 attention, with independent dense F32 cache ownership/alias guards. Past caches must maintain BF16-roundtrip FP32 invariant. Requires standalone GPU/FP64/canary/readonly/alias/roundtrip tests, separate plugin/lowering and same-precision full-model comparison before any admission. No runtime/DLL/source deployed or CMake registration changed.
